senses.gloss: 1. नौ encl. acc. dat. gen. du. of 1st pers. pron. (cf. Pāṇ. viii, 1, 20), RV. &c. &c. (VS. also णौ; cf. VPrāt. iii, 85).
2. नौ॑ f. a ship, boat, vessel, RV. &c. &c.
(in astrol.) N. of a partic. appearance of the moon or of a constellation, Var.
= वाच्, Nir. i, 11 (either because prayer is a vessel leading to heaven or fr. √ 4. नु, ‘to praise’).
नौ [cf. 2. नाव and 7. नु; Gk. ναῦς, ναύ-της, &c.; Lat. nāvis, nau-ta, nau-fragus &c.; Icel. nór; (?) Germ. Nachen.]
